title: Diner of the Damned
description: A surreal horror scene in a retro diner where a waitress with a worried expression stands over a man with bulging eyes and purple boils who has collapsed dead on the counter, spilling coffee. The purple walls are covered in dripping eyeballs, a painting of an endless hallway hangs behind an old television, and through the rain-streaked window two robotic figures and a woman with an umbrella are visible outside.
prompt: Surreal horror scene set inside a retro 1950s style diner with purple walls. A worried waitress in a brown uniform stands behind the counter looking at a dead man with bulging eyes and purple boils collapsed over the counter, coffee spilled. Multiple large dripping eyeballs cover the ceiling and floor. An old CRT television and a framed painting of an endless hallway with a figure are on the wall. Through the large window, heavy rain falls on two robot figures and a woman holding an umbrella. Goo and slime drip from everything, moody lighting, detailed digital painting.
